STEP 4. Check the harness wires between backup light 
switch connector B-37 and ignition switch (IG1).
NOTE: After checking intermediate connector C-28 and 
junction block connectors C-101 and C-107, check the wires. If 
intermediate connector C-28 and junction block connectors C-
101 and C-107 are damaged, repair or replace it. Refer to 
GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between backup light switch 
connector B-37 and ignition switch (IG1) in good 
condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair them. The backup light switch input signal 
should be able to be checked and the rear wiper 
should work normally.
